description: This file defines the 'Extension' class within the Opencart Catalog Model Setting namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve extension data such as all extensions, extensions by type, and a specific extension by code. It interacts with the database to fetch and return extension details.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Provides methods to manage and retrieve extension information from the database within the Opencart catalog setting model context.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all extension names from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extensions filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Fetches a specific extension matching the provided type and code.
